# smolpng repository automation

## Meaning

This is smolpng’s repository-owned automation configuration and canonical label mapping. Forgehand v0.2.4 (`5bdbacfa6009589cbaeb699c0cfbacacc1b84dff`) is enabled through `FORGEHAND_ENABLED=true`. [The initial qualification record](../../docs/reference/2026-10-17-forgehand-qualification.md) proves a real fixed-in-main reply and duplicate-free repeat of the same dispatch. Later ordinary PR integrations exposed [duplicate completion receipts across PR-close and main-push routes](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/smolpng/issues/5#issuecomment-6232341929); convergence for that combined event shape remains unqualified. The separate diffdevil Action caller has a qualified read-only hosted preview and remains disabled for writes. Managed sizing has a dated pending-enable observation; admission remains unresolved in [Issue #5](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/smolpng/issues/5).

## Policy and writers

[The label policy](../label-policy.json) owns the shared type/Needs vocabulary, six product areas and mechanical ownership. Maintainers apply semantic types and Needs labels through the ordinary authored account. The enabled Forgehand caller owns configured PR areas, intake and lifecycle effects; its outward actor is `wolfsblvt-automaton[bot]`. This is not a claim that every timer, control or fork journey has been exercised. Its cross-route completion defect retains shared-source repair custody. Preserve the historical receipts; await accepted source and an exact release/runtime coordinate before changing the consumer pin, then qualify the combined event shape. The sizing Action is disabled. A [17 October production read](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/smolpng/issues/5#issuecomment-6228538214) found managed execution `pending-enable`, history off and writer standing unverified. That snapshot is not fresh exclusive-writer proof or evidence that a size writer ran.

The product profile selects 90 days without non-bot replies plus 7 days after a delivered warning, a separate 14+7-day necessary-response request, and deliberate `still relevant` reopening. No hard metadata gate or automatic merge is selected. The one durable line is `main`; there is no `next` branch. The complete message files preserve these consequences.

Compression includes workflow/PNG/JPEG/toolchain source and the image corpus, not every CLI edit. Desktop includes native integration and shell menus; CLI interaction belongs to User Interface. Build includes CI, packaging and corpus generation tooling, while a routine source file does not make Build true. Documentation includes the corpus guide and license map; photographic binaries remain authored fixture material rather than generated size exclusions. Dependency recognition includes `go.sum` even though review sizing excludes that resolved checksum file. Original upstream license texts are excluded from sizing; authored notice integration stays counted.

## Activation and recovery

Use the [pinned Forgehand maintenance guide](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/forgehand/blob/5bdbacfa6009589cbaeb699c0cfbacacc1b84dff/docs/maintenance.md) for the existing mediated App credential route, exact repository permissions, named-object dry-run, event qualification and enablement. Do not copy raw keys into chat or substitute a personal write token. App `4662666` and installation `159902485` were qualified for this repository. The private key stays in the existing protected source and repository secret boundary; the trusted runtime verifies App identity and mints only this repository's Issues/PRs write token. Workflow `GITHUB_TOKEN` remains read-only.

Forgehand does not measure sizes. [The diffdevil policy](../../.diffdevil.yml) projects the canonical mapping into the released `size@1` preset: replacement-aware review lines, 20/100/500/1000 upper boundaries, the six existing size names, Go checksum/upstream-license exclusions and the repository's XL template. The Action uses `definitions: none`; it neither provisions nor rewrites label definitions. Keep this adapter projection consistent with `.github/label-policy.json` when changing size policy.

To stop this caller, set `FORGEHAND_ENABLED=false`; that does not change `main` protection or ordinary Verify CI. The current caller skips manual previews too while disabled. Keep it disabled during investigation and use the pinned planner through a qualified read-only route rather than toggling live writes merely to preview. Re-enable through a fresh plan and bounded provider observation.

## Sizing admission and operation

[Pull-request size](../workflows/pull-request-size.yml) pins diffdevil v1.0.0 (`0827485c9d3795ef58a7934cd7a4b8b3fb5cc9c5`) and the existing official App-token Action. It runs on trusted `main` PR events, without checking out or executing PR-head source. Manual dispatch is limited to the default branch. Policy and relative templates come from the current PR base; the read-only workflow token acquires them. Only an apply run mints an Automaton token, limited to this repository and Issues/PRs write, with ordinary post-job revocation. The caller verifies the App slug before invoking the writer.

`DIFFDEVIL_ACTION_ENABLED` is absent, so automatic and manual apply are disabled. A default-branch manual preview remains available without an App token:

```powershell
gh workflow run pull-request-size.yml --repo Wolfsblvt/smolpng --ref main -f number=PR_NUMBER -F apply=false
```

The caller rereads the current PR before minting a writer. Closed PRs and `🛠️ Manual Triage` pause it completely. `🛠️ No Auto-reply` selects only the size rule. Changes to either control trigger reconciliation; ordinary label events do not enter the job. Controls are observations before execution, not an atomic lock against a simultaneous maintainer change. diffdevil separately reacquires and checks the current comparison before effects. Unrelated labels and comments remain outside its managed subset.

Local qualification used the exact released distribution: thirteen plans exercised all band boundaries, paired replacements, exclusions, authored notices, binary Unknown and the rendered XL reply. Seven direct control-step cases covered ordinary, paused, reply-suppressed and closed PRs plus invalid input and a failed provider read. These support the candidate only; they do not prove hosted credentials, live size assignment, duplicate-free replies, fork operation or managed-App standing.

The first hosted preview refused apply-only comment-identity inputs in plan mode. [PR #21](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/smolpng/pull/21) repaired those inputs without changing apply identity or token scope. [Hosted preview 38990046803](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/smolpng/actions/runs/38990046803) then succeeded at caller/base `533a8f0ecd78c34931a2a6f607e267323d934111` against PR #20 head `b228f86d82aa7cb9c76d7f15bf7e952fd59ffa83`. Its rendered summary reported 18 included files, five unmeasurable binaries, one desired operation, one held rule and no applied provider effects. Both App-token steps were skipped. This qualifies real hosted read-only preview, not label/comment application.

Before setting the flag to `true`, establish that no managed App or former Action can write overlapping effects, reconcile in-flight work, preview a real current PR and complete the security review. Then dispatch one bounded apply and read back its exact head/base, policy, App actor and sole size label; repeat to establish convergence. Qualify XL, Unknown and control behavior at their actual boundaries rather than inferring them from a small PR. Disable this caller by setting `DIFFDEVIL_ACTION_ENABLED=false` before investigating a failure or admitting another writer. Cutover requires explicit disabled standing and settled in-flight effects for the old writer, followed by a real result from the replacement.

The managed service remains the selected final host. Its [Direction](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/diffdevil/blob/main/docs/DIRECTION.md) and [consumer guide](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/diffdevil/blob/main/docs/manual/use/managed-app/service.md) own service implementation and supported adoption. The [17 October production read](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/smolpng/issues/5#issuecomment-6228538214) confirmed installation `163370347` and repository access, with execution `pending-enable`, history off, 75 disabled rejections and no retained target leases, repairs or nonterminal deliveries in that snapshot. Installation access does not establish execution consent, effective policy or an active writer. The [service Lead's subsequent judgment](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/smolpng/issues/5#issuecomment-6228799659) identified a qualified production admission/policy caller as the remaining dependency; source factory availability is not a serving route, and direct database changes would bypass that boundary. Both writers stay unchanged while that service-owned dependency remains open. Before admission, resolve fresh App-authenticated reach, effective trusted policy and physical in-flight effects through the supported route. [Issue #5](https://github.com/Wolfsblvt/smolpng/issues/5) retains smolpng-side admission custody. No new credential or installation is selected by these observations.
